description: This file defines the TodoRepository class, which manages access to task and category data via DAO interfaces in a TODO list application. It provides methods for CRUD operations, searching, and filtering tasks and categories.

classes.name: TodoRepository
classes.description: Repository class that mediates access to task and category data through DAO interfaces. Provides coroutine suspend functions for CRUD operations, search, filtering, and ensuring categories exist.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all category entities from the database.

methods.name: ensureCategoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a category with a given name exists; if not, creates it and returns the entity.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category with the specified name if it does not already exist.

methods.name: renameCategory
methods.description: Updates the name of a category identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category by ID; related tasks are handled via foreign key constraints.

methods.name: searchAndFilterTasks
methods.description: Searches for tasks matching a query string and optionally filters by category.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Inserts a new task entity into the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a task entity from the database.

methods.name: getTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getDueTasksBy
methods.description: Retrieves tasks that are due before a specified timestamp.
